coordinates: Top-left origin; rects x,y,width,height; clip rectangles x1,y1,x2,y2 with exclusive far edges; frame indices zero-based except timeline frame counters (one-based).

preview.source: Current native Rust reconstruction, complete bounded scene-browser timelines
preview.limits: Preview samples every 3 script ticks. Final VM compositions shown; display-only transitions/crossfades and their extra wall time are omitted. Saved layers appear in images even when absent from the current tick draw list. Not a recording of the original Windows program.

runtime_support.backgrounds: Convert final 4x PNGs to SAHD and load backgrounds/NAME.SCR.rgba in a custom pack.
runtime_support.widescreen: Future manifest-aware renderer integration required; current renderer repeats edge scenery and does not use these canvases.
runtime_support.audio: Future external WAV loading/resampling required; current player reads the original EXE samples.
